function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The groups are confounded by `customer_segment`: the email campaign was targeted at high-value customers (loyal, returning), while paid_search attracted more new customers. A raw comparison of conversion rates between channels is invalid. Instead, we computed the difference in conversion rates within each segment (email - paid_search), then took a weighted average of these differences, weighted by segment size. This provides an adjusted estimate of the campaign effect, controlling for segment."}
